authority_statement: Human-readable JSON values are untrusted declarations and cannot become methodology, result, certificate, observation, resolution, family, or source authority.
conversion_statement: The closed adapter maps explicit human tokens only to the existing public manual-fact and bounded-request types.
execution_statement: The Runtime CLI delegates only through MethodologyKernel.analyze_bounded_manual_chart.
snapshot_statement: Output contains non-authoritative scalar diagnostics only and cannot be reloaded as input or authority.
